note: This sheet is RGB with no alpha channel, so slicing finds one piece covering the whole sheet. That is correct for a fixed-grid plate: select the single piece and use "Split selected on grid" at the layout below. 2172x724 as a 20x1 strip, so its cells are 109x724 - far from square, which the grid split handles. It already ships as a hand-written tileset built by art-source/tilesets/normalize_tilesets.py. Exporting over it would rewrite the ids and coordinates that GenMappingRegistry references, so treat this as a sheet to inspect or adopt deliberately, not to re-export casually. Note it loads as a sliced sheet addressed by frame index rather than as col/row doodads, so re-exporting it through this tool would change its shape in the registry, not just its coordinates.
